question.prompt: Mr. Green measures his rectangular garden by walking two of the sides and finds that it is \(15\) steps by \(20\) steps. Each of Mr. Green’s steps is \(2\) feet long. Mr. Green expects a half a pound of potatoes per square foot from his garden. How many pounds of potatoes does Mr. Green expect from his garden?

solutions.explanation:
First express both side lengths in feet, because the yield is given per square foot. The garden measures \(15\cdot2=30\) feet by \(20\cdot2=40\) feet. Its rectangular area is
\[
30\cdot40=1200\text{ square feet}.
\]
Each square foot produces an expected half pound, so the expected harvest is
\[
1200\cdot\frac12=\boxed{600\text{ pounds}},
\]
choice \(\text{A}\).
solutions.title: Convert the side lengths and apply the yield
